description: This file defines the PluginBlueprint class and its nested class ParsedPluginInfo, which are used to process and manage plugin interface data, including interface types, notification entries, and related metadata.

classes.name: PluginBlueprint
classes.description: Main class representing a plugin configuration, including interface processing and metadata.

classes.name: PluginBlueprint.ParsedPluginInfo
classes.description: Nested class responsible for parsing and extracting interface information, notification entries, and interface mappings from provided data.

methods.name: processInterfaces
methods.description: Processes parsed data to identify interface types, notification presence, and populate interface lists.

methods.name: extractRootName
methods.description: Static method to extract the root name from a full name string.

methods.name: hasNotification
methods.description: Checks if a class data object or its children contain a notification.

methods.name: gatherNotificationEntries
methods.description: Collects notification entries from class data based on naming and hierarchy.

methods.name: collectNotificationEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of collected notification entries.

methods.name: isJsonRpcPlugin
methods.description: Determines if the plugin is a JSON-RPC plugin based on tags in parsed data.

calls: any("json" in cls_data.m_tags for cls_data, _ in self._parsed_data.values())
